name: Pine Box
tagline: The operating system for funeral homes that would rather not lose the paperwork.
positioning: Pine Box runs the whole funeral home — intakes, arrangements, permits, invoices — so owner-operators stop chasing forms and start burying the busywork.

hero.h1: Death is inevitable. Losing the death certificate isn't.
hero.sub: Pine Box gives independent funeral homes one place to run arrangements, permits, and billing — so the only thing that slips through the cracks is the occasional casket handle.

features.title: At-need intake in minutes
features.description: Capture the family, the decedent, and the service details on one screen. Auto-fills the forms your county still wants in triplicate.

features.title: Permit & filing tracker
features.description: Burial-transit permits, death certificates, VA benefits — every deadline flagged before the coroner's office calls you first.

features.title: Arrangement builder
features.description: Drag caskets, urns, and packages into a quote the family can actually read. Prices update live; awkward math stays hidden.

features.title: Invoices that get paid
features.description: Send itemized statements, take card or ACH, and file insurance assignments without the fax machine you keep pretending works.

features.title: Pre-need pipeline
features.description: Track prearrangement contracts and trust balances so future business doesn't live in a filing cabinet named 'Dave.'

features.title: Staff scheduling
features.description: Assign directors, drivers, and embalmers across services and viewings. Nobody double-books the hearse again.

testimonials.quote: We used to run three services off a whiteboard and a prayer. Pine Box means I actually know which family is arriving at two o'clock without walking to the front desk.
testimonials.name: Marlene Okafor

testimonials.quote: The permit tracker paid for itself the first month. No more scrambling for a transit permit while a family waits in the lobby.
testimonials.name: Doug Reinhart

testimonials.quote: I hired a second director and had her fully onboarded in an afternoon. The per-seat pricing means I only pay when I actually grow.
testimonials.name: Priya Nair

pricing.blurb: For the one-director shop that does everything themselves.
For growing homes running multiple services a week.
For multi-location groups and acquisition rollups.

homepage.footerBlurb: Pine Box is software for funeral homes run by people, not conglomerates. We handle the paperwork so you can handle the families.
